name: 19079 · Sharon Hill, PA
findings: ZIP 19079 (Sharon Hill) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19079 (Sharon Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19079 (Sharon Hill) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
